BE ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF CHIPLEY, GEORGIA, and it is hereby ordsined by authority of same that on and after the adoption of this ordinance that each habitation within the City limits of Chipley shall be provided with one of the three facilities.

- 1. Connected to the city sewer systen.

- 2. or, provided with a flush toilet, septic tank and disposal field to meet the specification of the Georgia State Heaith Departnent.

- 3. or, a Sanitary pit privy constructed according to the plans of the Georgia State Health Department.
2:
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that any person or persons, firm or corporation failing to provide one of these for each habitation shell be guilty of disorderly conduct and on conviction shall be fined not exceeding $50.00 or confined in jail or work on the streets not exceeding 15 days.

SECTION Ift.

BE IT FURTHER ENACTED that if for any reason any part of this Ordinance is held to be unconstitutional or invalid such holding shall not affect or destroy the validity of any other part of this Ordinance.
3:
All ordinances or part of ordinance in conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed.

SECTION V. Said toilet facilities shall be inspected every six months and failing to neet requirements use of same shall he ordered discontinued until corrected.
4:
BE IT FURTHER ENACTED that when a pit toilet is no longer suitable for use it shali be destroyed and all open pots be backfilled with dirt.
